caption: The drawing depicts a toy train consisting of three connected parts on a plain, light beige background. The first part is a locomotive engine with a red and black color scheme, featuring a cylindrical black smokestack, a black boiler, a red body with black patches, a roof over the cab, and large spoked wheels, with the front wheels being smaller than the rear wheels. Attached to the locomotive is a rectangular, open-top red boxcar with four small spoked wheels, also showing black patchy marks. Behind the boxcar is a second wagon, also rectangular and red with black spots, featuring an open top and four similar wheels. The three sections are joined by simple metal hooks, forming a horizontal train arrangement. There is no visible background scenery or additional elements surrounding the toy train.
title: Toy Train
